title: Component Part 2.5: functional List + ComboBox (selection controls)
description:
DONE (task 1235, Part 2.5). Added mx.controls.List + mx.controls.ComboBox to the registry-driven component framework (packages/swf/src/compiler/components.ts). New declarative registry hooks: extraTextFields() (fixed row-pool of named row{0..7}_txt EditTexts), positioned SkinMark (movable hl_mk highlight), faceKind:'list', depth-layered encodeComponentSkinSprite (face<highlight<label_txt<rows<arrow). Items delivered via the GENERIC param path (labels/data array param -> setComponentParam -> __splitItems -> setItems); no frames.ts changes. List: stacked rows, click-to-select with movable highlight, selectedIndex/selectedItem/getSelectedItem/getLength/getItemAt + change broadcast. ComboBox: collapsed label_txt + arrow toggle showing/hiding the dropdown row pool, select-collapses-and-updates-label. DEFERRED (follow-on, NOT built): live scrollbar/scrolling for long lists, keyboard nav.

VERIFICATION (reproducible):
- Build/typecheck: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build => all packages Done (tsc clean).
- Structural unit tests: pnpm --filter @flash/swf run test -- --run => Test Files 115 passed (115); Tests 1439 passed (1439). Includes new component-place.test.ts 'functional selection controls: List + ComboBox' (ExportAssets+FQ class, DefineFunction2-before-registerClass, label_txt+8-row pool + highlight (+arrow), labels delivered via setComponentParam).
- Ruffle oracle: cd apps/desktop && npx playwright test e2e/component-oracle.spec.ts -g 'task 1235' => 4 passed. List items getItemAt(0)=='Apple' RED->BLUE (blue=20000); ComboBox items RED->BLUE; List click row1 selectedIndex==1 RED->BLUE (before red=20000/blue=0, after red=0/blue=20000); ComboBox collapsed-row click isOpen() RED->BLUE. Full spec: 15 passed (Parts 2.1-2.5, no regressions).
- core suite: only the ~3 pre-existing task-1207 FLA fixture failures (empty-bytematch, carchive-validate, contents-structure) remain; untouched by this task.
Render-oracle note: white field box on white SetBackgroundColor => raw non-white pixel count ~0, so the oracle probes the live item/selection model (RED->BLUE) instead of pixel-counting; not faked (runs in real Ruffle). docs/13 updated (Part 2.5 section).
